issue_context.title: reorgCtx should not maintained by worker
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

reorgCtx is maintained by DDL worker, it is better binding with the job, since a job may be running by different workers

review_comments: Please add comments for this map.
When will we encounter this logic？It(`rc == nil`) seems that we prepare start running backfill job which means no backfill workers need to cancel.

yes, please see `rollingbackAddIndex`.

consider we are trying to cancel an add index job, and at the same time the job is going to the last round, the cancel job txn commit first and run ddl job txn will get a write conflict and retry. The reorg context is remove by the last round so at the retry round it will has `rc==nil` and job canceling
it seems we can put this `if` before `rc==nil` stmt🤔
